game.insufficient_players: Insufficient players to play the game.
skill.runner.camouflage.desc: §lHiding§r lingers for up to 10 seconds after you stop crouching. Furthermore, you're more nimble in that state.
skill.runner.brawler.desc:
Punch killers to stun them. Each hit comes with great knockback, and adds 1.5s to their stun duration.

§cNote: Runners cannot attack while §lHiding§r§c.
skill.runner.medic.desc:
Dance at the bodies of recently-deceased teammates in order to revive them. This alerts the killer, but a successful revive will grant you points depending on band progression, and even more if they make it to the end.

Limit: §l2§r
Revive Time: §l10s
skill.runner.medic.revive: %s has been revived! They are now §csoul-bound§r to %s.
skill.runner.warper.desc:
Cross bands to gain §lTime§r §lWarps§r; upon use, your position warps 5 seconds back in time.

Cooldown: §l30s§r
Limit: §l2
skill.runner.alchemist.desc:
Cross bands to gain §lFlasks§r. Using one §lFlask§r consumes both.
- §lBlinding§r §lFlasks§r: when thrown, they blind any killers they hit, awarding you points upon band completion.
- §lStunning§r §lFlasks§r: Instead of blinding the killer, the killer gets stunned for half the time.

Cooldown: §l30s§r
Limit: §l1
skill.killer.athlete.desc:
Activate a dash to gain a huge boost to your speed and movement for several seconds.

Cooldown: §l15s
skill.killer.locator.desc:
Gain a compass that tracks the farthest runners within a 32m radius. This compass can be used to "lock-on" to the current target temporarily, before going on cooldown.

Cooldown: §l20s
skill.killer.locator.notification: Somebody has locked onto your position.
skill.killer.gemini.desc: Spawn with two bodies, being able to freely swap between them. Your inactive body is quite vulnerable, and may be permanently killed by the runners after 10 hits.
skill.weapon.dagger.desc: Melee-only weapon that increases damage and movement speed slightly, but decreases your attack cooldown.
skill.weapon.trident.desc: Can be thrown for more damage, even while stunned. Recalls when thrown.
skill.weapon.foreseer.desc:
Fires spectral arrows that, upon hitting a block, reveal all nearby runners. While on cooldown, it only fires normal arrows.

Cooldown: §l20s
